rows.jyutping: zi6 jin4 wui5 kaau3 gan6 A
rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice when a person or thing tends to move toward a person or target.

example.english: When I see fresh desserts, I naturally gravitate toward them.
example.traditional: 見到有新鮮嘅甜品，我自然會靠近嗰邊。
example.jyutping: gin3 dou2 jau5 san1 sin1 ge3 tim4 ban2 ngo5 zi6 jin4 wui5 kaau3 gan6 go2 bin1

rows.note: Use this for a physical object moving downward or falling under gravity, rather than being drawn toward a target.

example.english: Once the apple comes off the branch, it will gravitate downward.
example.traditional: 個蘋果一離開樹枝就跌落去喇。
example.jyutping: go3 ping4 gwo2 jat1 lei4 hoi1 syu6 zi1 zau6 dit3 lok6 heoi3 laa3
